name: Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells industrial gases in China and internationally. The company offers oxygen, nitrogen, liquid oxygen, liquid nitrogen, liquid argon, high-purity oxygen, and krypton xenon special gas. It also provides piped, easyjet, dewar, and bottled gas supply, as well as gas supply from storage tanks services. In addition, the company is involved in project investment; transportation activities; engineering and technical research; and gas and equipment sale.
